title: POPANE-R5 Pre-authorized Physiology-Family Ablation
classification: Exploratory/post-primary sensitivity explicitly allowed by the frozen R1 protocol.
purpose: Test whether the R1 all-physiology degradation masks incremental forecasting value in a narrower predeclared physiological family.
reuse_from_r1: Identical file inclusion/QC, common anchors, targets, 1/11/21/31 s horizons.
Identical deterministic subject folds and primary simultaneous held-person × held-segment exclusion.
Identical naive recent-state persistence and fitted context features (prior_affect + time_norm).
Identical Ridge alpha grid/training-only participant GroupKFold and HGB hyperparameters.

per_family_horizon_learner: delta_naive_family = MAE(naive)-MAE(family); positive favors family over persistence
delta_context_family = MAE(context)-MAE(family); positive is incremental family value beyond learned context
endpoints.uncertainty: Participant-cluster bootstrap with 5000 resamples, matching R1 for comparability.

multiplicity_firewall: This is a three-family × four-horizon × two-learner exploratory screen after R1.
No single positive cell may be promoted as confirmatory.
A potentially meaningful family rescue requires the SAME family and horizon to have delta_context_family 95% CI strictly above zero for BOTH Ridge and HGB.
Any positive rescue must be independently reproduced or supported in CASE before a manuscript claim.

decisions.NO_FAMILY_RESCUE: No family×horizon has both Ridge and HGB delta_context_family 95% CIs strictly above zero.
decisions.MODEL_ROBUST_FAMILY_RESCUE: At least one family×horizon has both learners strictly positive versus context.
decisions.FAMILY_SCREEN_MIXED: Any model-specific positive effects without cross-model agreement.

firewalls: A null family result does not prove physiological irrelevance.
No causal, bodily-necessity, universal, or phenomenal inference.
paper_role: Attack the objection that all-channel feature burden, rather than lack of incremental information, caused R1 physiology degradation.
